cause_quote: The introducing diff added `"id": "kie"` and `"enabledByDefault": true` to the new plugin manifest while omitting both `extensions/kie/assets/icon.png` and `extensions/kie/assets/activity.svg`.
user_saw: The Control UI showed generic fallback artwork for Kie’s plugin identity and video activity.
summary: The fix bundled the shared OpenClaw identity PNG and the existing Vydra video activity SVG with Kie and documented their sources.
reasoning: The activity artwork convention was already in place when Kie was introduced. I checked the introducing diff and the history of `extensions/kie`, which show that the new bundled plugin shipped without either asset and that both paths first appeared in this fix. The fix PR reproduced the missing-file inventory failure and both Control UI fallbacks.
